title: AGNT: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
body: AGNT posts record Q2 revenue $1.4B, beats guidance and estimates, tightens EBITDA outlook amid macro caution

questions.question: What number changed versus what was already priced?
questions.note: Q2 revenue printed at **$1.4B** (up 11% YoY), beating guidance of **$1.35B–$1.45B**, but **adjusted EBITDA guidance was tightened to $17–$22M** (vs. implied $30.7M in Q2 actual). questions.question: Is this one named issuer, or a factor that should not be pinned to a camera ticker?
questions.note: This is a **named issuer (AGNT)**—not a factor—since the print tied **specific guidance (EBITDA) to a ticker (AGNT) in the lede**. The **$1.4B revenue** is a book print, while the **EBITDA guidance cut** is a factor impulse (macro-driven, not inventory).

questions.question: If guidance was only reaffirmed, why is an up call illegal?
questions.note: An **up call is illegal** because the **EBITDA guidance downgrade** (a **downward factor impulse**) contradicts the **revenue beat** (upward book print). The **mixed direction** (revenue up, EBITDA guidance down) violates the **print_vs_priced** rule for this family.
